title: dracocephalum spicatum
intro: Dracocephalum spicatum, commonly known as Dragon Flower or Wolf's Mint, is a perennial plant native to China and parts of Europe. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving stress, and promoting digestion. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a nervine, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of Dracocephalum spicatum include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
